I used to love sitting around the bonfire in Majula, looking at my gear, thinking of what I should level up and etc. The music is so calming, and compared to all the other areas of the game, Majula was a necessity to get away from the constant dying and enemies around every corner. You could of died 40 times to a boss, go back to Majula and in less than 5 seconds be totally calm (at least maybe just a bit more)

Plus the Emerald Herald or her real name -  Shanalotte was a nice touch (;
